Not really good for carseats that have a handle installment. Wont wrap correctly but other than that its perfect. Soft and strong baby holds it and interacts

reviews.name: Kelsey
reviews.title: Baby LOVES!!
reviews.body: Bought this for my 8 week old so he would have something fun to look at and play with during a road trip and it was a hit! His favorite is the jingly dinosaur. I love that the toy has a universal fit so we will be able to use it even after he transitions out of his infant seat. The toys are super soft and you can easily move around the toys to change the order, with that being said however because the toys are only attached by a small piece of velcro, they do pop off very easily on accident.

reviews.name: Jenn Hanson
reviews.title: Cute and versatile
reviews.body: We really like this toy! It works great wrapped around the car seat handle, but we also use it on his activity/play gym bar when he’s lying on his back looking up at his toys. I love that we can easily move it from one place to another instead of it only being useful on the car seat. It keeps him interested and gives him something cute to look at and reach for. Definitely a good little toy for the newborn/young baby stage!
